─── Spec Context ───
Session Branch Worktree Management
Type: requirement
Implementation: in_progress
Description:
  Git worktree management for the session branch mode. Creates and
  maintains an orphan branch with its own worktree at .kspec-sessions/.
Acceptance Criteria:
  [ac-init]
    Given: sessions.storage is "branch" and no session worktree exists

    When: kspec init or kspec setup runs

    Then: Creates orphan branch with configured name (default "kspec-sessions"),
adds worktree at .kspec-sessions/.

  [ac-commit-boundaries]
    Given: sessions.storage is "branch"

    When: Session lifecycle events occur (create, close, stale cleanup, compact)

    Then: Auto-commits to session branch at lifecycle boundaries only.
Event appends during active sessions are NOT committed individually.

  [ac-sync]
    Given: sessions.storage is "branch" and remote tracking is configured

    When: Daemon shadow sync runs

    Then: Session branch syncs independently from kspec-meta.
Sync failures on one branch do not affect the other.

  [ac-status]
    Given: sessions.storage is "branch"

    When: kspec shadow status runs

    Then: Reports health of both kspec-meta and session branch worktrees.

  [ac-repair]
    Given: Session worktree is broken or disconnected

    When: kspec shadow repair runs

    Then: Repairs session worktree independently from kspec-meta worktree.


─── Notes ───
